notes: Dashboard is now included in regular Foundry updates. A prominent Dashboard button beside Update opens the execution map in a separate window, reuses that window on repeated clicks, and provides a normal link if popups are blocked. Includes the source-mapped simulation, source inspector and optional read-only project observation. Simulation does not run or verify generated apps. Existing projects, credentials, model routes and approval/execution controls are preserved. Use the Update button for this and future published releases; no separate Dashboard edition installation is needed.
